title: hex8 linear-elastic reference FEA (engine.verify.reference_fea)

governing_equations.name: linear static equilibrium
governing_equations.description: Assembled trilinear hex8 stiffness K times nodal displacement u equals nodal load F; solved by Jacobi-preconditioned CG (or direct SuperLU below the DOF cap).

governing_equations.name: isotropic linear elasticity
governing_equations.expr: sigma = D(E, nu) : epsilon,  epsilon = sym(grad u)
governing_equations.description: Small-strain constitutive law; von Mises reduces the stress tensor to the reported scalar.

governing_equations.name: SIMP homogenisation (optional)
governing_equations.description: When simp_penalty p is set, element modulus is penalised by density; reported stress is the homogenised rho_eff^p * D B u, NOT a solid-material stress.

assumptions: Linear elastic, small displacement, small strain — no plasticity, contact, or geometric nonlinearity.
Trilinear C0 hex8 elements on a regular voxel grid; geometry is occupancy-sampled at voxel_mm.
Static loading; inertia/damping ignored (see ace_modal for dynamics).
Binary as-built occupancy (rho >= 0.5) unless SIMP mode is explicitly requested.

boundary_conditions.fixtures: clamped = all 3 translational DOF fixed on selected nodes; pinned/slider constrain the named dof_constrained subset. Selectors resolve to grid nodes touching active elements.
boundary_conditions.loads: point = resultant distributed over selected nodes; body = per-volume force x element volume; pressure = traction over the selected face. A load selector catching > 30% of active elements is flagged 'suspiciously broad'.
boundary_conditions.selector_count_unit: nodes (active grid nodes touching the selected active elements)

discretization.notes: Regular voxel grid at voxel_mm; supersample=2 antialiases the occupancy sample.

validation.ground_truth: Euler-Bernoulli + shear cantilever: delta = PL^3/(3EI) + 1.2 PL/(GA) = 0.2934 mm for L=40, b=h=8 mm, P=10 N, E=2.2 GPa, nu=0.37.
validation.direction: under-predicts peak/tip response; hex8 is stiff; error converges from below toward the analytic value under refinement.

caveats: Coarse hex8 grids under-predict peak bending stress by roughly 20% vs a converged mesh.
In SIMP mode the reported stress is homogenised (rho_eff^p * D B u), not a solid-material stress.
Stair-stepped voxel boundaries introduce spurious surface stress concentrations at coarse resolution.

limits_of_validity.slenderness: pin measured at L/h = 5; very slender or very stubby members not separately pinned here
limits_of_validity.resolution: quote strut/feature stresses as approximate below ~4 voxels across the feature
